meta.name: medusa-store
meta.description: Reference for the Medusa.js store backend, its Next.js storefront, and the Claude-powered AI store agent. Use this whenever working on the store backend/frontends — product catalog, checkout, digital products, the storefront chat widget, or any of the AI agent's store-management tools (create_product, list_orders, etc.).

copy.tagline: 查询电商店铺开发的技术参考
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在开发电商商店并需要随时查阅技术细节。
copy.tagline_en: Look up technical details for building an online store
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing an e-commerce store and need technical reference.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会参考这份资料回答 Medusa 店铺后端、店面等开发问题:商品目录、结账、数字商品等场景,以及创建商品、查订单等管理工具的使用。
howto.when: 当你在处理店铺后端或店面,涉及商品目录、结账、数字商品等,或使用管理代理工具(如创建商品、查订单)时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下店铺最近的订单,按状态筛选一下。
say.note: 会调用 list_orders 之类的管理工具。

say.text: 创建一个商品,标题和价格我发你,描述你帮我用阿拉伯语写。
say.note: 调用 create_product,缺描述时代理会自己补。

say.text: 客户发来了订单号,帮我查他的订单并起草回复。
say.note: 通过 answer_customer 查单并拟回复。

howto.what_en: Claude uses this as a reference for the Medusa store backend, the storefront, and the AI store agent: product catalog, checkout, digital products, plus admin tools such as create_product and list_orders.
howto.when_en: Triggered when working on the store backend or frontends: product catalog, checkout, digital products, the storefront chat widget, or admin tools like create_product and list_orders.

say_en.text: Check the latest store orders and filter them by status.
Create a product; I'll give you the title and price, and you write the Arabic description.
A customer sent their order number, look up the order and draft a reply.
say_en.note: Uses answer_customer to fetch order and draft a response.
